title: Siege of Barcelona (1651)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Barcelona (1651)", at revision 1376000952, opens: "The siege of Barcelona took place between July 1651 and October 1652 during the Reapers' War when a large Spanish army descended on Barcelona and besieged the garrison made up of Catalans and French troops under Philippe de La Mothe-Houdancourt." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q717431, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1651-1652 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
